name: Cosmicon, Roll On Again!
description: Will the "Cosmicon Collective" fire the opening shot in the trade war sparked by the arrival of the Furbobo Weekly pop-up store in Seafeld City? Talk to Paraprince to kick off your business empire in Seafeld City! Your rank may not always roll up, but your dice certainly will.
introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
The annual Seafeld City "Commerce Street Showdown" kicks off! You'll take on the role of Furbobo Weekly's President and team up with brand Ambassador Silver Wolf to face off against Seafeld City's local brands in epic Cosmicon Collective battles.

◆ Event Rules ◆
● During the event, "Cosmicon Collective" will feature a 2v1 co-op mode where Trailblazers will team up with Silver Wolf and use collected character cards to battle opponents, while utilizing dice attached to the cards for offense and defense.
● In co-op mode, you can swap dice and use Tactics Cards to secure victory more easily.
● Defeat opponents to earn various tokens. Use different tokens to purchase new cards and dice, or Gild your cards.
● Once you complete the story battles, online challenges will unlock, allowing Trailblazers to team up with others from different worlds and take on even more formidable foes together.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Participate in co-op challenges and defeat formidable foes. Once the total of your Highest Scores reaches a certain threshold, you can claim the corresponding rewards.

◆ Limited-time Rewards ◆
Complete limited-time missions during the event period to obtain exclusive event rewards.

◆ Event Reminders ◆
● After the "Cosmicon, Roll On Again!" Limited-Time Event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards during the event period, but they can still visit the Seafeld City map to speak with Paraprince, experience the event, and obtain permanent rewards.
